directions.name: Direction A — AeroTrack multi-source research system
directions.question: Can an integrated detection -> single-target state estimation -> forecasting system, assembled from several published components plus new logic, track tiny UAVs in thermal / visible video, and which components actually help?
directions.nature: integrated research system (published components, adaptations, new designs); every component claim must be backed by a controlled experiment

directions.name: Direction B — Anti-UAV (2021) paper reproduction: DFSC on GlobalTrack
directions.question: Does a faithful re-implementation of the paper's DFSC training on GlobalTrack reproduce the paper's Protocol II IR numbers, and does DFSC beat plain fine-tuning?
directions.nature: single-paper reproduction; deviations are tagged S1-S6 in docs/ANTI_UAV_REPRODUCTION_SPEC.md; follow-ups (Phase B, H3, H4, A2 visible) are labelled as such

directions.name: Shared benchmarks, protocols and external baselines
directions.question: Not a research direction: benchmarks, protocols, pretrained bases and published / released baselines used by the directions.
